arguments.script: var roots=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetActiveScene().GetRootGameObjects(); foreach(var g in roots){foreach(var r in g.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer>(true)){if(r.sortingOrder<0 || r.name.Contains("Background"))UnityEngine.Debug.Log(r.name+" order="+r.sortingOrder+" layer="+r.sortingLayerName+" sprite="+(r.sprite?r.sprite.name:"null")+" path="+UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(r.sprite));}} foreach(var c in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType<UnityEngine.Camera>())UnityEngine.Debug.Log("CAM "+c.name+" "+c.transform.position+" size="+c.orthographicSize+" aspect="+c.aspect+" components="+string.Join(",",c.GetComponents<UnityEngine.Component>().Select(x=>x.GetType().Name)));
arguments.summary: Inspect current background renderers and active camera before integrating parallax
